component.name: Steward
component.summary: Browse your files and keep folders tidy

description.p: Steward is a file manager for Ubuntu that keeps folders tidy. It shows a plan before anything moves, and one Undo puts everything back.

ul.li: Tidy sorts a messy folder into kind folders after showing you the plan
Find any folder or file by name as you type
Folder sizes on every folder, worked out in the background
Two folders side by side, with copy and move across
Workspaces gather folders and files from anywhere on one page
Free Up Space shows what is safe to clear and why; everything goes to the Trash
Installed lists what apt, Snap, Flatpak and the language tools installed
About This Computer shows battery health, storage and security at a glance

description.p: Steward works on your files where they are. Nothing is uploaded and nothing is tracked.

screenshot.caption: A folder with its files as cards and its folders as glass folders
Free Up Space: what is safe to clear, and why

description.p: The first release: a file manager for Ubuntu that keeps folders tidy.
